diagnosis: Mixed germ cell tumour of the mediastinum

legend: This mixed germ cell tumour of the anterior mediastinum  has components of yolk sac tumor and teratoma and grows into the adjacent lung. The yolk sac tumour shows mostly solid, microcystic, and spindle cell patterns. The teratoma forms glands, cartilage, and glia. Despite the atypia of the teratomatous elements, which reflects their malignant nature, an independent somatic-type malignancy should not be diagnosed because of the absence of overgrowth of a single-type of teratomatous element.
